\bigskip \bigskip

# Supplementary Information

**Estimating the sampled source signatures.**

Similarly to MixSIAR [@stock2018], MixMustR estimates the source signature for the $k^{\text{th}}$ tracer from the $j^{\text{th}}$ sampled source $\mu_{j, k}$, as well as its standard deviation, $\sqrt{\pi_{n, j}^2 \omega_{j, k}^2}$, based on the user-supplied mean, $x_{j, k}$, standard deviation, $s_{j, k}$, and sample size, $m_{j, k}$:

$$
  m_{j, k} \sim \chi^2(\nu_{j, k})
$$
$$
  x_{j, k} \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_{j, k}, \left(s_{j, k} / \sqrt{m_{j, k}}\right)^2)
$$
$$
  \omega_{j, k} = \sqrt{(s_{j, k}^2 (m_{j, k} - 1)) / \nu_{j, k}}
$$
$$
    \forall j = 1, \dots, J, \quad \forall k = 1, \dots, K.
$$

```{r}
#| label: fig-s1
#| fig-cap: "**Mean posterior predictions vs. (simulated) mixing proportions in synthetic Dataset 1 of MixMustR, based on underlying mixing proportions for data stream 1.** Posterior predictions were obtained from the MixMustR model variants 2--4 all of which allow for hierarchical a structure. Variant 2: sampled sources' tracers are fixed at the user-informed mean, and unsampled source is calculated (fixed) as the mean across all sampled sources. Variant 3: sampled sources' tracers incorporate uncertainty, and unsampled source is estimated based on the uncertainty across all sampled sources. Variant 4: sampled sources' tracers are fixed at the user-informed mean, and unsampled source is estimated based on the uncertainty across all sampled sources. Colours and shapes represent the different models, and the dashed diagonal line represents the 1-to-1 reference: the closer the points are to the 1-to-1 line, the better the model fit."
#| include: true
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| fig.width: 7.2
#| fig.height: 6.1
#| out.width: 95%
fig_s1
```

# $\text{ln}\rho_{n, j}$ and $\sigma_{\text{ln}\rho_{n, j}}$ as priors

Here we consider the alternative parametrisation case in which $\text{ln}\rho_{n, j}$ and $\sigma_{\text{ln}\rho_{n, j}}$ are treated as prior information for $\zeta_{n,j}$. We do this for model variant 6 which is the simplest model in MixMustR: sampled sources' tracers are fixed at the user-informed mean, the unsampled source is calculated (fixed) as the mean across all sampled sources, and every observation is treated as independent:

$$
\zeta_{n,j} \sim \mathcal{N}\left(\text{ln}\rho_{n, j}, \sigma_{\text{ln}\rho_{n, j}}^2\right).
$$
$$
\forall n = 1, \dots, N, \quad \forall j = 1, \dots, J + 1, \quad \forall k = 1, \dots, K.
$$

\noindent We fit this alternative parametrisation to Dataset 2 (divergent), and also set $\sigma_{\text{ln}\rho_{n, j}}$ = 1 (high uncertainty). Results and convergence diagnostics can be seen in @fig-s26, @fig-s27 and @fig-s28.

The dashed diagonal line represents the 1-to-1 reference: the closer the points are to the 1-to-1 line, the better the model fit."
